news.title: Q2 2025 Earnings Date Announced
news.text: Tenable scheduled the release of its second-quarter 2025 financial results for July 30, including a same-day conference call.

news.title: Tenable Named Leader in Unified Vulnerability Management
news.text: An independent research firm ranked Tenable as a leader for unified vulnerability management solutions, citing its exposure management strategy.

news.title: AI-Powered Breakthrough in Vulnerability Prioritization
news.text: Tenable introduced new AI-driven capabilities designed to improve how security teams prioritize vulnerabilities across their environments.

news.title: Tenable Named Customers' Choice by Gartner Peer Insights
news.text: Gartner Peer Insights recognized Tenable as a Customers' Choice for Vulnerability Assessment, underscoring strong customer satisfaction.

news.title: Tenable One Surpasses 300 Integrations
news.text: The company highlighted that Tenable One now supports more than 300 integrations, promoting what it called the industry's most open exposure management platform.

news.title: Q2 2025 Earnings Beat Forecasts
news.text: Tenable reported second-quarter 2025 revenue of $247.3 million and EPS of $0.34, both ahead of analyst estimates, while noting 12% year-over-year revenue growth and progress in exposure management.

news.title: Share Repurchase Program Expansion
news.text: The board approved a $250 million increase to Tenable's share repurchase program following its quarterly results.

news.title: Tenable Names New Chief Financial Officer
news.text: Matthew Brown was appointed CFO, succeeding Steve Vintz, who transitioned to the role of Co-Chief Executive Officer.

news.title: IDC MarketScape Recognizes Tenable as Leader
news.text: The IDC MarketScape report named Tenable a leader in worldwide exposure management, citing the strength of the Tenable One platform.

news.title: State of Cloud and AI Security Report Released
news.text: Tenable Research published its State of Cloud and AI Security 2025 study outlining ongoing challenges in cloud-security management.

news.title: Tenable Ranked #1 in IDC Market Share
news.text: IDC reported that Tenable held the top 2024 global market share for device vulnerability and exposure management.

news.title: Exposure Management Leadership Council Formed
news.text: Tenable launched the Exposure Management Leadership Council with leading CISOs to develop proactive risk management frameworks.

news.title: Tenable Posts Q3 2025 Earnings Beat
news.text: Tenable reported third-quarter 2025 revenue of $252.4 million, up 11% year over year, with a 23.3% non-GAAP operating margin and 437 new enterprise platform customers, prompting an increased full-year outlook.

news.title: Analysts React to Tenable Results
news.text: Following earnings, Canaccord Genuity reiterated a Buy rating while D.A. Davidson trimmed its price target to $32 on concerns about growth moderation.
